roadmap.title: Opening Run — Chapters 1–2
roadmap.blurb: Play the story in order from Gone Fishing to the end of Chapter 2. Sample each activity once as it unlocks and keep your partner close — the partner trophies are easiest while the duo is together.

roadmap.title: Vice City Rising — Chapters 3–4
roadmap.blurb: Push through the Vice City chapters and their heist set-pieces. Stock armour and ammo before each finale, and keep making story choices as they appear — the choice counter only grows during the story.

roadmap.title: Story Finale
roadmap.blurb: Finish the last set-pieces and the final mission. Make a manual save before the finale so you can replay the ending, then turn to free roam with the whole map open.

roadmap.title: Strands & Partners
roadmap.blurb: Clear the stranger strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — and finish the partner free-roam trophies while partner time is still plentiful.

roadmap.title: Activities & World
roadmap.blurb: Gold the Shooting Range, win the races, work the robberies and money trophies, and clear the open-world one-offs. Fold the 250 stunts into your driving between venues.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & 100% Sweep
roadmap.blurb: The long tail: card sets, WAiNK It locations, vehicles, areas, garages and registrations. Sweep one kind at a time with the checklist filters until the completion counter reads 100%.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.blurb: When every other trophy is earned, the platinum pops on its own. Nothing extra to do — this stage is the victory lap.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: follow the roadmap stages in order, clear the story, then sweep collectibles and activities, and this unlocks last.

steps.t: Open the Docket and confirm this case has no task of its own — it closes only when the other 54 trophies are earned.
Work the roadmap stages 1 to 6 in order so no trophy is left stranded behind you.
Clear the story first, following the stage order in this guide.
Sweep the collectibles next: card sets, WAiNK It locations, vehicles and areas.
Clear every activity type so the activity trophies are not the last ones standing.
Check the progress header after each session and note the earned count out of 54.
If the count stalls, filter the Docket to unearned cases and work the lowest stage first.
Re-check the hidden trophies — one still unearned is the usual reason this case stays open.
Verify: at 54 of 54 the platinum unlocks by itself — there is nothing extra to press or buy.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, in any order.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, until its end cutscene. It is the first story mission, so this unlocks naturally within the opening hour; no side content is needed first.

steps.t: Start a new game and follow the opening prompts as they appear.
Setup: no side content is needed first — this case opens inside the first hour.
Begin the first story mission, Gone Fishing, from the mission prompt.
Play Gone Fishing through its objectives in order, from start to finish.
Stay with the mission until its end cutscene begins.
Verify: the trophy pops at that end cutscene, inside the opening hour.
If you drift into free roam, return to the story marker and resume Gone Fishing.
Confirm the case shows earned in the Docket before moving to Chapter 1 cleanup.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — it is the first story mission and the story cannot be advanced past it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter closes with its final mission's end screen, and the trophy pops there. If you are unsure whether a mission belongs to the chapter, the in-game mission log lists chapters in order.

steps.t: Open the in-game mission log and list every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Setup: chapters are mandatory, so no preparation beyond playing in log order is needed.
Play each Chapter 1 story mission in sequence without skipping ahead.
Use the mission log whenever you are unsure whether a mission belongs to Chapter 1.
Finish the chapter final mission and stay for its end screen.
Verify: the trophy pops on that final mission end screen.
If a mission was failed, retry it from its checkpoint — there is no permanent fail.
Tick the case earned and move on to Chapter 2 in the roadmap order.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — story chapters are mandatory and cannot be skipped or failed permanently.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear all Chapter 2 story missions. This chapter leans on the drug-trade storyline, so expect a mix of driving, deals and shootouts; the trophy lands when the chapter's last mission completes.

steps.t: Continue the story into Chapter 2 once Chapter 1 has closed.
Setup: expect a mix of driving, deals and shootouts across this chapter.
Clear each Chapter 2 story mission in log order.
On driving legs, keep the vehicle intact so the deal legs start clean.
On deal legs, follow the mission objectives rather than improvising.
On shootout legs, use cover and retry from checkpoint if a mission fails.
Complete the chapter last mission in full.
Verify: the trophy lands when that last mission completes.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a mandatory story chapter; failed missions simply retry from checkpoint.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3's mission chain until its finale. The chapter brings the story into Vice City proper, so use the new safehouse and contacts it opens up before moving on.

steps.t: Follow the Chapter 3 mission chain in order from where Chapter 2 ended.
Setup: this chapter brings the story into Vice City proper.
Set up at the new Vice City safehouse the chapter opens for you.
Use the new contacts the chapter opens for ammo and vehicles.
Work each Chapter 3 mission in sequence toward the finale.
Restock at the safehouse before starting the chapter finale.
Finish the chapter finale mission in full.
Verify: the trophy pops at the finale end screen.
Confirm the safehouse and contacts stay available before you leave the chapter behind.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a mandatory story chapter that gates all later content.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 mission chain. By now the story's stakes are at their highest, and the chapter's finale is a long set-piece, so stock up on armour and ammo before starting it.

steps.t: Work through the Chapter 4 mission chain in order.
Setup: the story stakes are at their highest here, so prepare before the finale.
Stock full armour, ammo and snacks before starting the chapter finale.
Clear each Chapter 4 mission in sequence, retrying from checkpoints when needed.
Start the long finale set-piece only with armour and ammo topped up.
Push through the finale set-piece to its final objective.
Verify: the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
If the finale stalls, retry it — it can be attempted as often as needed.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a mandatory story chapter; the finale can be retried as often as needed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. It is a gold trophy because it closes the whole campaign; make a manual save before starting it so you can replay the ending freely afterwards.

steps.t: Make a manual save before starting the final mission — this is the setup that protects the ending.
Setup: bring full armour, your best weapons and a fast car to the start marker.
Start the final story mission from that manual save point.
Complete the final mission through each of its phases in order.
Reach the mission end screen without skipping the closing sequence.
Verify: the gold trophy pops as the campaign closes.
Afterwards, reload the pre-finale save if you want to replay the ending freely.
Confirm the case is earned, then turn to free roam with the whole map open.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — the final mission is mandatory, and a pre-finale save lets you replay the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission log. It is a story beat, so it cannot be skipped or failed permanently; if you fail it, simply retry from the checkpoint.

steps.t: Watch the mission log for Breakfast Run to appear.
Setup: it is a story beat, so it cannot be skipped or failed permanently.
Start Breakfast Run when it appears in the log.
Follow its objectives in order from the start marker.
If you fail it, retry from the checkpoint — there is no permanent fail.
Finish the mission in full.
Verify: the trophy pops at the results screen.
Tick the case earned before continuing the Chapter 1 chain.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a sequenced story mission that stays available until played.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so complete any setup objectives the game hands you before the heist itself unlocks.

steps.t: Setup: complete every setup objective the game hands you before the heist itself unlocks.
Note each setup objective as it appears and clear them one at a time.
Start The Cartel Heist once the setups unlock it.
Work the heist phases in order, following the mission waypoints.
Protect the take on the escape leg — do not split from the objective route.
Finish the mission through to its results screen.
Verify: the trophy pops at the results screen.
If any phase fails, retry it — setups and the heist itself can both be retried.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a story heist in the main chain; setups and the heist itself can be retried.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks in sequence; play the missions in order and it will appear when the story reaches it.

steps.t: Play the story missions in order until Child's Play appears.
Setup: it is a named story mission, so it unlocks in sequence with no side work first.
Start Child's Play from the mission log or its map marker.
Complete its objectives in full, in the order the mission presents them.
Stay through the closing sequence rather than leaving early.
Verify: the trophy pops at the results screen.
If the mission fails, retry from its checkpoint and finish it in full.
Confirm the case earned, then continue the Chapter 3 chain.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a sequenced story mission in the main chain.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The DWNFALL title hints at a fall-from-grace story beat; finish the mission's objectives in full and the trophy pops at the results screen.

steps.t: Reach Headliners in the Chapter 4 mission chain.
Setup: the DWNFALL title marks a fall-from-grace story beat — no extra preparation is listed.
Start Headliners from the mission chain when it becomes current.
Play the mission and finish every objective in full.
Do not leave objectives partial — the case needs the mission completed whole.
Verify: the trophy pops at the results screen.
If an objective fails, retry from checkpoint until the mission completes.
Tick the case earned and continue the Chapter 4 chain in order.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a sequenced story mission in the main chain.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the Vice City airport. Expect heavy resistance on the tarmac; a fast car parked nearby for the getaway makes the escape leg much smoother.

steps.t: Setup: park a fast car near the airport before starting VCIA Takedown.
Start VCIA Takedown at the Vice City airport when the chain reaches it.
Fight through the tarmac resistance with armour on.
Work the mission objectives in order across the airfield.
Use the parked fast car for the getaway leg.
Finish the mission through to its results screen.
Verify: the trophy pops at the results screen.
If the escape leg fails, retry — the airport set-piece can be attempted again.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a sequenced story mission; the airport set-piece can be retried.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a large-scale assault, so bring heavy weapons and body armour, and follow the mission's waypoint chain rather than improvising.

steps.t: Setup: bring heavy weapons and full body armour to the start marker.
Start Operation Savage Glory when the late story chain offers it.
Follow the mission waypoint chain rather than improvising a route.
Push through the assault phase by phase toward the final objective.
Keep armour topped up between phases using what you brought.
Complete the final objective of the operation.
Verify: the trophy pops when the operation completes.
If a phase fails, retry from its checkpoint — the operation is retryable throughout.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — a late story operation in the main chain, retryable from checkpoints.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed into it. Check the stats screen regularly; the last few percent are almost always one missed collectible set or activity type.

steps.t: Open the in-game completion checklist and note every category feeding the 100 percent.
Setup: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed this counter.
Finish the story in full so the story share reads complete.
Finish all stranger strands across Leonida.
Try every activity type so no activity category is left at zero.
Sweep the collectibles: card sets, WAiNK It spots, vehicles and areas.
Check the stats screen regularly and hunt the category that is short of 100 percent.
The last few percent are almost always one missed collectible set or activity type — clear that set.
Verify: the gold pops the moment the checklist reads 100 percent — track progress with the counter in this case.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — every input to 100% stays available in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses, airtime and other stunt-driver moments all count. The fastest grind is a fast bike on the highway, chaining jumps off ramps and near-misses in traffic; the in-game stats page tracks your stunt total.

steps.t: Setup: take a fast bike onto the highway — bikes chain stunts fastest.
Hit ramps and jumps for airtime stunts.
Weave through traffic for near-miss stunts between jumps.
Mix the stunt kinds: jumps, near-misses and airtime all count toward the same total.
Check the stats page for your stunt total after each run.
Return to the highway and repeat the ramp-and-traffic loop.
Use the counter in this case to track progress toward 250 as you grind.
Keep chaining stunts in free roam — they can be farmed at any point in the game.
Verify: the silver pops when the counter reaches 250 stunts.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — stunts can be farmed in free roam at any point in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once: racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone racing, meditation, hunting and minigames. Visit each venue once and the trophy pops; you do not need to win or score well, just try each one.

steps.t: Setup: list the 9 activity types first — racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, drone racing, meditation, hunting and minigames.
Visit a racing venue and try one race.
Visit the shooting range and try one challenge.
Visit a fishing spot and try fishing once.
Visit an arcade and try one cabinet.
Continue with bowling, drone racing, meditation, hunting and minigames — one visit each.
You only need to try each type once — no wins or scores are required.
Verify: the trophy pops when the 9th different type registers.
All 9 venues stay open in free roam, so any missed type can be sampled later.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — all 9 activity venues stay open in free roam for the whole game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Use a steady weapon with a good sight, take your time on the precision rounds, and replay any challenge from the range menu until it shows gold; scores are per-challenge, so you can improve them one at a time.

steps.t: Open the Shooting Range menu and note all 42 challenges.
Setup: pick a steady weapon with a good sight for the precision rounds.
Play each challenge once to learn its layout and scoring.
Take your time on the precision rounds rather than rushing shots.
Replay any non-gold challenge from the range menu.
Scores are per-challenge, so improve them one at a time.
Track the gold count with the counter in this case as challenges turn gold.
Return to the range menu whenever a challenge needs another attempt — all can be replayed.
Verify: the silver pops when all 42 challenges show gold.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — every range challenge can be replayed from the range menu at any time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's racing line on a practice run first, then go for the win; cutting corners through gates cleanly matters more than raw speed.

steps.t: Find a Top Fun drone race start on the map.
Setup: run the course once as practice to learn the gate line.
Note where cutting corners through gates cleanly saves more than raw speed.
Race again and fly the clean line through the gates.
Win the race at that location.
Move to the next location and repeat the practice-then-win pattern.
Tick each win off with the counter in this case.
Drone races can be retried at every location until won, so no win is ever lost.
Verify: the trophy pops when all 14 locations have a win.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — drone races can be retried at every location until won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the state's race types: street, off-road, boat and air races all count as long as each race is a distinct event. The map marks race starts; winning the same race twice does not add to the count.

steps.t: Open the map and pick an unraced race start marker.
Setup: street, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each is a distinct event.
Enter the race and win it.
Move to a different event each time — winning the same race twice does not add to the count.
Work across the race types so distinct events stay easy to find.
Track distinct wins with the counter in this case.
Race events stay on the map and can be retried until won.
Verify: the trophy pops when 20 distinct races are won.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — race events stay on the map and can be retried until won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Match the lure to the spot, keep the line tension in the safe zone, and reel steadily; Cal's score is the target to beat, and you can retry the challenge if he wins.

steps.t: Find Cal at his fishing spot and accept his challenge.
Setup: match your lure to the spot before casting.
Cast and keep line tension in the safe zone while you reel.
Reel steadily rather than in bursts, keeping tension in the safe zone throughout.
Watch Cal's score — his score is the target to beat.
Out-score Cal by the end of the contest.
Verify: the trophy pops when you beat Cal in the fishing challenge.
If Cal wins, challenge him again straight away — the challenge can be retried.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Cal's challenge can be retried until you beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game in full, from start to its end screen. Pick the shortest cabinet you find in an arcade, learn its controls in the first round, and play it through; high scores are not required.

steps.t: Enter any arcade and look over the cabinets.
Setup: pick the shortest cabinet you find in the arcade.
Learn the controls in the first round before pushing for completion.
Play the game through round by round toward its end screen.
High scores are not required — completion is what this case records.
Verify: the trophy pops when the arcade game completes at its end screen.
Arcade cabinets can be replayed as often as you like if a run ends early.
Tick the case earned and count the arcade toward your activity-types case as well.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — arcade cabinets can be replayed as often as you like.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until his last mission. Stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so check the map for Andy's icon between story chapters and clear each of his jobs in order.

steps.t: Watch the map for Andy's strand icon between story chapters.
Setup: stranger strands unlock as the story progresses, so check back after each chapter.
Start Andy's strand from his map icon.
Clear each of Andy's jobs in the order they unlock.
Return between chapters whenever a new Andy job appears.
Start his final mission when it appears on the map.
Complete the final mission in full.
Verify: the trophy pops on the final mission results screen.
Andy's strand stays on the map until finished, even after the story ends.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — stranger strands stay on the map until finished, even after the story ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's full mission strand. His jobs tend to involve boats and the coast, so keep a fast boat handy; the trophy pops when his final mission's results screen appears.

steps.t: Find Kenton's icon on the coast and start his strand.
Setup: keep a fast boat handy — his jobs tend to involve boats and the coast.
Clear Kenton's missions in order as they unlock.
Use the fast boat for his water legs so travel does not stall the strand.
Return for each new mission as the strand progresses.
Start his final mission when it appears.
Finish the final mission in full.
Verify: the trophy pops when the final mission results screen appears.
Kenton's strand remains available in free roam until completed.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Kenton's strand remains available in free roam until completed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand to its final job. Billy's strand is the biker strand, so a good motorcycle helps; clear his missions in order whenever his icon appears on the map.

steps.t: Start Billy's biker strand when his icon appears on the map.
Setup: bring a good motorcycle — most of his jobs are on two wheels.
Clear Billy's missions in order whenever his icon appears.
Keep the motorcycle ready between jobs so each new mission starts fast.
Work the strand through to its final job.
Complete the final job in full.
Verify: the trophy pops at the final job results screen.
Billy's strand stays available until its final mission is done.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Billy's strand stays available until its final mission is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. There are more than 8 strands available, so pick the shortest ones first and use the map icons to track which strands you have finished; each strand's final mission counts once.

steps.t: Setup: pick the shortest strands first — Andy, Kenton and Billy are quick.
Start a strand from its map icon and work its missions in order.
Finish the strand fully — only its final mission counts toward the 8.
Track finished strands with the map icons and the counter in this case.
Move to the next strand and repeat the full clear.
There are more than 8 strands available, so a strand you dislike can be swapped for another.
All strands stay available after the story, so none of the 8 needs rushing.
Verify: the silver pops when the 8th strand final mission completes.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — more than 8 strands exist and all stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Clear Randy's mission strand through to his final job. Randy's strand is the supply-and-demand chain, so expect fetch-and-deliver work; finish each of his missions as they unlock.

steps.t: Start Randy's strand when his icon appears.
Setup: his strand is the supply-and-demand chain, so expect fetch-and-deliver work.
Keep a roomy vehicle ready for the delivery legs.
Run his fetch-and-deliver jobs as they unlock, in order.
Finish each mission as it unlocks rather than letting the strand stall.
Start his final job when it appears.
Complete the final job in full.
Verify: the trophy pops at the final job results screen.
Randy's strand stays on the map until finished.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Randy's strand stays on the map until finished.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's strand to its last mission. His jobs centre on the city scene, so check for his icon after story chapters; the trophy unlocks on his final mission's completion screen.

steps.t: Check for Tyrone's city icon after each story chapter.
Setup: his jobs centre on the city scene, so his icon appears around story progress.
Start Tyrone's strand from his icon when it appears.
Clear his jobs in order as they unlock.
Return after later chapters if a new Tyrone job unlocks late.
Play his last mission when it appears.
Complete the last mission through to its completion screen.
Verify: the trophy unlocks on that completion screen.
Tyrone's strand remains available in free roam until completed.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Tyrone's strand remains available in free roam until completed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and meditate at all 18 meditation spots across the map. The spots sit at scenic viewpoints; use the atlas in this guide's roadmap section to tick them off one by one, and the trophy pops at the last one.

steps.t: Head to a scenic viewpoint marked as a meditation spot.
Setup: the spots sit at scenic viewpoints across Leonida.
Interact to meditate and let the sequence finish.
Work region by region so no viewpoint is missed.
Tick each spot off with the counter in this case.
Use the roadmap stage for this case to plan the sweep order.
Meditation spots are permanent world locations, usable at any time.
Verify: the trophy pops at the 18th and final spot.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — meditation spots are permanent world locations, usable any time.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow the trail clues Bret gives, move quietly once you are close, and take the shot only when the animal is in the open; a missed shot can spook it, so save before the final approach.

steps.t: Take the hunt from Bret and note the trail clues he gives.
Setup: save before the final approach — a missed shot can spook the animal.
Follow the trail clues to the animal's area.
Move quietly once you are close to the animal.
Wait until the animal is in the open before lining up the shot.
Take the shot only when the animal is in the open.
Return to Bret with the hunt complete.
Verify: the trophy pops when the hunt completes.
If the animal is spooked, track it again — Bret's hunt can be re-attempted.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Bret's hunt can be re-attempted; a spooked animal can be tracked again.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect enough cards to complete 3 full sets. Cards hide in shops, houses and out in the world; trade duplicates with other collectors in-game, and check the collection screen to see which sets are one card short.

steps.t: Search shops, houses and world spots for collectible cards.
Open the collection screen to see which sets are closest to done.
Setup: focus your hunting on the three nearest-complete sets.
Trade duplicates with in-game collectors to fill gaps in those sets.
Check the collection screen after each trade to see which set is one card short.
Hunt the missing cards for the nearest set first.
Complete one full set, then repeat the focus for the next.
Cards and trades stay available for the whole game, so no card hunt is time-boxed.
Verify: the silver pops when the 3rd set is completed — track sets with the counter in this case.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — cards and trades stay available for the whole game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. It is a long grind, so fold it into normal travel: open WAiNK It at every new landmark, shop and viewpoint you pass, and the count climbs steadily.

steps.t: Open WAiNK It at the first landmark you visit.
Setup: make it a habit — use it at every new shop, viewpoint and landmark you pass.
Fold WAiNK It stops into normal travel so the count climbs steadily.
Sweep one region at a time during the collectibles stage.
Track the count with the counter in this case after each session.
Locations stay usable and the count is cumulative across the whole game.
If a region runs dry, move the sweep to the next region rather than revisiting used locations.
Verify: the silver pops at the 100th different location.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — locations stay usable; the count is cumulative across the whole game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges of any kind: driving, shooting, exploration and activity challenges all count. Open the challenges menu and clear the easy ones first; the counter ticks up per challenge, not per category.

steps.t: Open the challenges menu and sort by the easiest first.
Setup: driving, shooting, exploration and activity challenges all count.
Clear the easy challenges first to build the total quickly.
The counter ticks per challenge, not per category, so variety is optional.
Work down the menu, retrying any challenge that needs a second attempt.
Challenges can be attempted and retried at any time.
Track the running total with the counter in this case.
Verify: the trophy pops when the total reaches 50 challenges.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — challenges can be attempted and retried at any time.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the countryside or water to shake the search, and do not let your partner get caught or the attempt resets.

steps.t: Setup: pick up your partner in free roam — they must be beside you for this case.
Confirm you are in free roam, not in a mission where the partner is absent or scripted away.
Commit crimes until the wanted level reaches 4 stars.
Break line of sight: head for the countryside or out on the water.
Stay hidden until the stars clear.
Keep your partner safe throughout — if they get caught, the attempt resets.
Do not re-enter the search area while the stars are clearing.
Verify: the trophy pops when the heat fully clears with your partner present.
Window: only possible while your partner is with you in free roam — partner time becomes scarce late in the story, so file this case early.

trophies.missableWhen: Only possible while your partner is with you in free roam — it cannot be done during missions where the partner is absent or scripted away.
trophies.window: Only possible while your partner is with you in free roam — it cannot be done during missions where the partner is absent or scripted away.
trophies.missableWhy: Missable in practice — it needs your partner present in free roam, and partner free-roam time becomes scarce late in the story.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping the same wanted level active throughout. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and avoid raising the heat to the point the police pin you down.

steps.t: Setup: scout three shops close together and bring your partner along.
Confirm your partner is present in free roam before the first robbery.
Rob the first shop and keep the wanted level active as you leave.
Move fast to the second shop — do not let the stars clear.
Rob the second shop with the same wanted level still running.
Move fast to the third shop, still holding the wanted level.
Rob the third shop back-to-back with the same wanted level running.
Escape afterwards, avoiding heat so high the police pin you down.
Verify: the trophy pops once the third robbery registers — track the run with the counter in this case.
Window: needs your partner in free roam — do it before the story final stretch, when partner free-roam time becomes scarce.

trophies.missableWhen: Needs your partner present in free roam; do it before the story's final stretch, when partner free-roam time becomes scarce.
trophies.window: Needs your partner present in free roam; do it before the story's final stretch, when partner free-roam time becomes scarce.
trophies.missableWhy: Missable in practice — it needs your partner in free roam, which is plentiful early and scarce near the finale.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find and enter 100 different vehicles. Every new model you sit in counts, so hop into anything unfamiliar you pass: traffic, parked cars, boats and bikes all add to the tally shown in the stats screen.

steps.t: Sit in every unfamiliar vehicle you pass — traffic and parked cars count.
Setup: every new model you sit in counts once toward the tally.
Include boats, bikes and aircraft; each new model adds one.
Check the stats screen for the discovered-vehicle tally.
Vary your hunting ground: rich districts, docks and airfields spawn rare models.
Hop into unfamiliar parked vehicles whenever you pass a new area.
Track the tally with the counter in this case.
Vehicles spawn all game long and the tally is cumulative, so there is no deadline.
Verify: the trophy pops at 100 different vehicles discovered.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — vehicles spawn all game long and the tally is cumulative.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and drop 5 enemies before it ends. Start it in a crowded firefight with enemies in the open, aim for quick headshots, and keep moving so the meter does not run out mid-spree.

steps.t: Find a crowded firefight with at least 5 enemies in the open.
Setup: let the group bunch up before you commit.
Position so the bunched enemies stay in the open when you start.
Activate Combat Focus.
Chain quick headshots while the meter runs.
Keep moving so the meter does not run out mid-spree.
Drop the 5th enemy before Combat Focus ends.
Verify: the trophy pops on the 5th takedown inside a single Focus use — track attempts with the counter in this case.
Firefights and gang spots can be revisited whenever you need another attempt.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — firefights and gang spots can be revisited whenever you need another attempt.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and take off without following the airport's normal flow. The runway is the obvious route; expect a wanted level the moment you cross the fence.

steps.t: Setup: go to Vice City International Airport in free roam, not mid-mission.
Confirm the airport area is open and you are not inside a mission.
Cross onto the airfield and grab a plane.
Expect a wanted level the moment you cross the fence.
Take off down the runway without following the airport normal flow.
Keep the departure unscheduled — that is what this case records.
Verify: the trophy pops on departure.
Window: doing this mid-mission can fail the mission instead — always file it as a free-roam departure.

trophies.missableWhen: Best done in free roam after the airport area is open; doing it mid-mission can fail the mission instead.
trophies.window: Best done in free roam after the airport area is open; doing it mid-mission can fail the mission instead.
trophies.missableWhy: Window-sensitive — it must be a free-roam departure; attempting it mid-mission fails the mission instead of counting.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into the thick of it with Rhino tanks — survive and fight around them rather than avoiding them. The trophy is tied to tank encounters in the open world, so head to military or high-heat areas where Rhinos deploy.

steps.t: Raise your heat or head to a military area where Rhinos deploy.
Setup: this case is tied to tank encounters in the open world.
Stay in the fight around the tanks instead of fleeing.
Survive the encounter in the thick of it, close to the Rhinos.
Keep fighting around the tanks until the encounter registers.
Verify: the trophy pops once the tank encounter registers.
High-heat encounters can be triggered again whenever you want another attempt.
Tick the case earned once the encounter has registered.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — high-heat encounters can be triggered again whenever you want them.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean without ever being spotted. Case the store first, go at a quiet hour, move slowly inside, and leave before the alarm trips; if a guard spots you, the attempt is blown and you should reload.

steps.t: Case the jewelry store first and note its layout and guards.
Setup: make a save outside the store before you go in.
Enter at a quiet hour.
Move slowly inside, staying out of guard sight.
Take the goods without any guard spotting you.
Leave before the alarm trips.
Verify: the trophy pops on a clean, undetected robbery.
If you are detected, reload the save outside and try again — that attempt is void.
Window: a single detection voids the run, so the outside save is part of the filing, not an optional extra.

trophies.missableWhen: A failed detection during the robbery voids that attempt — reload a save made outside the store and try again.
trophies.window: A failed detection during the robbery voids that attempt — reload a save made outside the store and try again.
trophies.missableWhy: Attempt-sensitive — a single detection voids the run, so it is only safe with a save made outside the store first.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan the getaway vehicle before you go in, and treat each vault as its own job; the count is cumulative, so you can spread them across the whole playthrough.

steps.t: Pick a bank vault and park your getaway vehicle before going in.
Setup: treat each vault as its own job with its own getaway plan.
Rob the vault and get out fast.
Escape and clear the wanted level — the vault only counts on a clean escape.
Repeat at a second vault with a fresh getaway vehicle parked first.
Repeat at three more vaults, one clean escape at a time.
Track successful vault escapes with the counter in this case.
The count is cumulative, so vaults can be spread across the whole playthrough.
Verify: the silver pops after the 5th successful vault escape.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — vaults can be robbed across the whole playthrough and the count is cumulative.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck on the road and escape with the take. Block it in or force it to stop, grab the cash, then break the wanted level quickly — a fast car waiting nearby makes the escape leg trivial.

steps.t: Spot an armored truck on the road and follow it.
Setup: a fast car waiting nearby makes the escape leg trivial.
Block the truck in or force it to stop.
Grab the cash from the truck.
Jump in the fast car straight after the grab.
Break the wanted level quickly.
Verify: the trophy pops on escape with the take.
Armored trucks keep spawning on the roads all game long, so a lost truck is never the last one.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — armored trucks keep spawning on the roads all game long.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 named areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so drive the full road network and check the area counter in the stats screen for the regions you have not set foot in yet.

steps.t: Drive the full road network — the map fills in as you travel.
Setup: all 52 named areas register when you enter them on foot or by vehicle.
Check the area counter in the stats screen for unvisited regions.
Plan a route through the areas still missing.
Enter each named area so it registers on the map.
Recheck the stats counter after each region sweep.
The whole map stays open and explorable after the story.
Track visited areas with the counter in this case.
Verify: the trophy pops when all 52 areas have been visited.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — the whole map stays open and explorable after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are marked once discovered; work through the list gang by gang, and check the stats screen to see which gangs you have already hit.

steps.t: Discover a gang's illegal operation so it is marked on the map.
Setup: work the list gang by gang rather than revisiting gangs already hit.
Rob the operation and get clear.
Check the stats screen to confirm that gang is ticked off.
Move to the next gang and discover its operation.
Rob that operation and confirm the tick on the stats screen.
Track gangs hit with the counter in this case.
Gang operations stay marked and robbable once discovered.
Verify: the trophy pops when the 9th gang's operation is robbed.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — gang operations stay marked and robbable once discovered.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: sit at the bar, order, and let the scene play out; the trophy pops once the drink is served with the ocean in frame.

steps.t: Head to a bar on Ocean Beach.
Setup: this is a quiet moment case — no score, race or fight is involved.
Sit at the bar.
Order a cocktail.
Let the scene play out with the ocean in frame.
Stay for the full scene rather than standing up early.
Verify: the trophy pops once the drink is served with the ocean in frame.
The Ocean Beach bars are always open, so the moment can be taken at any time.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — the Ocean Beach bars are always open for a quiet drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out through the glass front of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, build speed on the forecourt, and crash through; the trophy pops on the exit.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI easter eggs

steps.t: Setup: pick a vehicle showroom with a big glass front, in free roam.
Confirm you are between chapters — a story mission can lock the showroom area.
Get in a car inside the showroom or take one onto the forecourt.
Line the car up facing the glass front.
Build speed on the forecourt aimed at the glass.
Crash straight through the window in classic style.
Verify: the trophy pops on the exit through the glass.
Window: do it in free roam at a quiet moment between chapters, not while a mission holds the area.

trophies.missableWhen: Do it in free roam — a story mission can lock the showroom area, so pick a quiet moment between chapters.
trophies.window: Do it in free roam — a story mission can lock the showroom area, so pick a quiet moment between chapters.
trophies.missableWhy: Window-sensitive — a story mission can lock the showroom area, so it needs a quiet free-roam moment between chapters.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your shots. It is a nod to the classic bowling scene: complete the game, and the trophy pops at the final frame regardless of your score.

steps.t: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Setup: score does not matter — a full game is what this case records.
Start a full game at the alley.
Follow through on your shots as you bowl.
Play through every frame without quitting early.
Finish the final frame.
Verify: the trophy pops at the final frame regardless of your score.
The bowling alley can be replayed any time if a game is left unfinished.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — the bowling alley can be replayed any time; score does not matter.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment that draws a crowd — build your duo's following until the game marks the partnership as a hit. It ties into the duo's public profile, so keep doing partner activities and the milestone lands on its own.

steps.t: Setup: keep doing partner activities together in free roam.
Build the duo's public following as you play.
Push partner time before the final chapter, while the duo arc is live.
Keep choosing partner activities over solo ones during the story phase.
Watch for the partnership moment that draws a crowd.
Stay with the moment until the game marks the partnership as a hit.
Verify: the trophy pops when the partnership milestone draws its crowd.
Window: the partnership peak is a story-phase moment that wraps up by the final chapter — file this case before the finale.

trophies.missableWhen: Tied to a story-phase partnership peak; push partner activities before the final chapter, when the duo's public arc wraps up.
trophies.window: Tied to a story-phase partnership peak; push partner activities before the final chapter, when the duo's public arc wraps up.
trophies.missableWhy: Missable in practice — the partnership peak is a story-phase moment that wraps up by the final chapter.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices until the counter reaches 500 — the PSN tracker counts choices across the whole game. Play naturally, pick the dialogue and mission options the game offers, and the tally builds up over a full playthrough.

steps.t: Setup: never skip a dialogue or mission choice — pick an option every time one is offered.
Choose actively in conversations, deals and mission branches.
Treat every offered option as one count toward the 500.
Watch the PSN tracker count climb as you play.
Keep choosing through the middle chapters, where choices are densest.
Do not go passive late in the story — the tally must be built before the finale.
Track the choice count with the counter in this case where you can.
Verify: the trophy pops when the counter reaches 500 choices.
Window: the counter only counts choices made during the story — after the final mission there is little left to choose.

trophies.missableWhen: The counter only counts choices made during the story; after the final mission there is little left to choose, so decide actively as you play.
trophies.window: The counter only counts choices made during the story; after the final mission there is little left to choose, so decide actively as you play.
trophies.missableWhy: Missable in practice — choices exist mainly during the story, so a passive playthrough can finish short of 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. Fail a mission or challenge, then retry and clear it; the trophy recognises the retry, so do not reload an old save to erase the first failure.
sources: GTA Forums — GTA VI trophy discussion

steps.t: Setup: pick a mission or challenge you can retry from its retry prompt.
Fail it once — let the failure register.
Do NOT reload an old save; that wipes the failed attempt from the tally.
Retry the same mission or challenge from the retry prompt.
Clear it on the second attempt.
Verify: the trophy pops on the successful retry.
Window: the failure must be followed by a retry, not a save reload — a reload erases the first attempt entirely.
If you reload by habit, fail and retry a fresh attempt rather than reusing the wiped one.

trophies.missableWhen: The failure must be followed by a retry, not a save reload — if you reload an earlier save, the failed attempt is wiped from the tally.
trophies.window: The failure must be followed by a retry, not a save reload — if you reload an earlier save, the failed attempt is wiped from the tally.
trophies.missableWhy: Attempt-sensitive — reloading a save erases the recorded failure, so the second-attempt success never registers.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange random events. Roam the wilder corners of the map at odd hours — the swamps, the desert roads, the coast at night — and the game will eventually throw something unexplainable at you.
sources: GTA Wiki — GTA VI random events

steps.t: Setup: head out at odd hours — night works best.
Roam the wilder corners of the map: the swamps, the desert roads, the coast at night.
Stay out in those areas rather than fast-travelling through them.
When something strange starts, stay in the area.
Witness the event through to its end.
Verify: the trophy pops once the strange event registers.
Strange random events keep occurring in the wild corners, so keep roaming if none appears.
Tick the case earned once an event has been witnessed in full.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — strange random events keep occurring in the wild corners of the map.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee weapon while driving past. Drive slowly beside a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon from the driver's seat, and connect; a quiet street with foot traffic is the easiest place to line it up.

steps.t: Equip a melee weapon and get in a car.
Setup: find a quiet street with foot traffic.
Drive slowly alongside a pedestrian.
Line up the pass so the pedestrian is on the driver side.
Swing the melee weapon from the driver seat as you pass.
Connect with the swing for the knockdown.
Verify: the trophy pops on the knockdown.
It can be attempted on any street with pedestrians, as often as needed.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — it can be attempted on any street with pedestrians, as often as needed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to a contact to wash them, and the total is cumulative across the whole game, so keep laundering as you earn.

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Setup: take the bills to a laundering contact to wash them.
Hand the bills over to the contact and let the wash complete.
Repeat after every score — the total is cumulative across the game.
Track the washed total with the counter in this case.
Marked Bills keep coming from robberies, so the supply never closes.
Keep laundering as you earn rather than saving bills for one large wash.
Verify: the trophy pops when 250,000 dollars has been laundered.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — Marked Bills keep coming from robberies and the laundered total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops: clothes, weapons, food and car parts all count. Buy what you need as you play and the total climbs; check the stats screen if you are close and top up with ammo or outfits.

steps.t: Buy what you need as you play — clothes, weapons, food and car parts all count.
Setup: the spend total is cumulative across all shops.
Check the stats screen for your total shop spend.
Keep spending naturally as the story pays out.
If you are close, top up with ammo or outfits.
Track the spend with the counter in this case.
Shops stay open all game, so there is no spending deadline.
Verify: the trophy pops when the total reaches 100,000 dollars spent.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — shops stay open all game and the spend total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Each costs in-game cash, so save for them as the story pays out; the property menu shows which garages you own and which are still for sale.

steps.t: Save cash as the story pays out — garages are bought, not earned.
Setup: open the property menu to see which garages are still for sale.
Buy the first garage as soon as you can afford it.
Buy each further garage as your cash allows.
Recheck the property menu after each purchase so none is missed.
Track owned garages with the counter in this case.
Garages stay for sale until bought — only your cash balance gates them.
Verify: the trophy pops when all 8 garages are owned.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — garages stay for sale until bought; only your cash balance gates them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, add each vehicle you own or find, and repeat until the counter hits 10; any vehicle model counts, so use the cheapest ones you already own.

steps.t: Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone.
Setup: any vehicle model counts, so use the cheapest ones you already own.
Register a vehicle you own or have just found.
Repeat with a different vehicle for each registration.
Keep registering until the counter in this case reaches 10.
Vehicles are everywhere, so registrations can be done at any time.
Verify: the trophy pops at 10 registrations.
Tick the case earned and let the registrations feed your vehicle-discovery tally as well.

trophies.missableWhy: Not missable — vehicles are everywhere and registrations can be done at any time.
